ui.headerTitle.d: Titolo nell'intestazione se il nome azienda non è impostato

ui.helpLink.d: Testo del collegamento alla guida (se configurato)

ui.helpdeskDefault.d: Usato se il contatto help desk non è impostato

home.title.t: What would you like to do?

home.subtitle.t: Manage the password of your work account on your own.

home.reset.text.t: Reset it by verifying your identity

home.unlock.text.t: Unlock it after too many failed attempts

home.account.text.t: You know your password: change it or register your verification methods

login.subtitle.t: On a company PC you can sign in directly with your Windows account.

login.windowsUnavailable.t: Windows sign-in is not available on this PC: use your user name and password.

login.windowsOnly.t: Sign in from a company PC with your Windows account.

account.notManageable.title.t: Account not managed by the portal

account.notManageable.text.t: For security reasons this account (administrative, service or out of scope) cannot use the portal. Please contact the help desk.

enroll.enrolled.t: You have {count} methods registered. You can use them to reset your password or unlock your account.

enroll.notEnrolled.t: Register at least {min} methods: you will need them to reset your password or unlock your account without calling the help desk.

enroll.disabled.t: Verification methods are managed by the help desk.

totp.text.t: Open the app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or similar), add an account and scan the QR code.

totp.manual.t: If you cannot scan it, enter this key:

dest.email.label.t: Personal email address (not your work one)

stepup.text.t: For security reasons, confirm with one of your registered methods.

stepup.totpHint.t: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.

change.mismatch.t: The two passwords do not match.

change.done.text.t: Use the new password right away. On your other devices (phone, mail) update it when asked.

pwd.err.minLength.t: The password must be at least {min} characters long.

pwd.err.maxLength.t: The password cannot be longer than {max} characters.

pwd.err.control.t: The password contains characters that are not allowed.

pwd.err.complexity.t: The password must contain at least three of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and symbols.

pwd.err.name.t: The password cannot contain the user name or parts of the name.

pwd.err.banned.t: The password contains a word that is not allowed (for example the company name).

flow.progress.t: Verifications completed: {done} of {required}. Choose how to receive the code.

flow.sent.t: Code sent to {destination}. If it does not arrive within a few minutes, choose another method.

flow.totpHint.t: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.

flow.noCode.t: If you do not receive any code, your account may not be registered with the portal: contact the help desk {helpdesk}.

flow.next.t: Verification successful. Complete the next one.

unlock.text.t: Verification completed. Confirm to unlock your account.

done.reset.text.t: You can now sign in with your new password. Update it on your phone and mail when asked.

done.unlock.text.t: You can now sign in again with your password.

err.rateLimit.t: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

err.verifyBlocked.t: Too many failed verifications for this account in the last 24 hours: for your security try again tomorrow or contact the help desk ({helpdesk}).

err.notManageable.t: This account cannot use the portal: contact the help desk.

err.windowsRequired.t: For this operation sign in from a company PC with your Windows account.

err.stepUpRequired.t: First confirm your identity with a registered method.

err.emailCorporate.t: Enter a personal email address, different from your work one.

err.codeExpired.t: Code expired or too many attempts: request a new one.

err.totpInvalid.t: Invalid code: check the time on your phone and try again.

err.minMethods.t: At least {min} methods are required: add another one before removing this one.

err.removalDisabled.t: Removing methods is not allowed: contact the help desk.

err.sendFailed.t: Could not send the code. Try again or use another method.

err.pwdRequirements.t: The new password does not meet the requirements.

err.pwdBreached.t: This password appears in lists of stolen passwords: choose another one.

err.pwdBreachUnavailable.t: The breached-password check is not available: try again later.

err.wrongCurrent.t: The current password is not correct.

err.adRejectedChange.t: Active Directory rejected the password: it may have been used recently or changed too recently.

err.accountLocked.t: The account is locked: use the unlock feature.

err.changeFailed.t: Password change failed. Try again or contact the help desk.

err.tooManyCodes.t: Too many wrong codes: start again.

err.adRejectedReset.t: Active Directory rejected the password: it may have been used before (history), the password may have been changed too recently, or it does not meet the requirements. Choose another one or contact the help desk.

err.resetFailed.t: Reset failed. Contact the help desk.

err.unlockFailed.t: Unlock failed. Contact the help desk.

err.unexpected.t: Unexpected error. Try again or contact the help desk.

err.busy.t: Service temporarily busy: try again shortly.

notify.code.sms.t: {company}: code {code} for {purpose}, valid {minutes} min. Do not share it.

notify.methodAdded.sms.t: {company}: method {method} added to your account. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.methodRemoved.sms.t: {company}: method {method} removed from your account. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.passwordChanged.sms.t: {company}: password of account {user} changed. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.passwordReset.sms.t: {company}: password of account {user} reset. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.accountUnlocked.sms.t: {company}: account {user} unlocked. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.adminUnlock.subject.t: Account unlocked by the help desk - {company}

notify.adminUnlock.sms.t: {company}: account {user} unlocked by the help desk. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.adminClearEnrollment.sms.t: {company}: verification methods of account {user} cleared by the help desk. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.adminTemporaryReset.subject.t: Password reset by the help desk - {company}

notify.adminTemporaryReset.sms.t: {company}: temporary password set by the help desk on account {user}. If this wasn't you, contact the help desk immediately ({helpdesk}).

notify.expiry.body.t:
Hello {displayName},
the password of your account {user} expires on {expiry} (in {days} days).
Change it now at {portalUrl}: from a company PC it only takes a few seconds.
If you have not done it yet, also register your verification methods: you will need them if you forget your password.

{company}

notify.expiry.sms.t: {company}: the password of account {user} expires in {days} days. Change it at {portalUrl}.

notify.invite.body.t:
Hello {displayName},
register your verification methods at {portalUrl}: you will need them to reset your password or unlock your account on your own, without calling the help desk.
It only takes a few minutes from a company PC.

{company}
